title: Three Billy Goats Gruff
rating_justification: Target rating R applied (recommended: PG-13). While the story features cyberpunk violence, industrial decay, and aggressive dialogue, it lacks the extreme graphic gore, pervasive profanity, or explicit sexual content required for an R rating. The violence is stylized and mechanical (cybernetic combat) rather than visceral or realistic. The 'Troll' dialogue is menacing but serves as a thematic representation of technological decay.
